name: alejandrothegreat
description: Discord music bot with a web dashboard, called Alejandrothegreat. Paste a Spotify link/playlist or just search terms and it plays the matching audio from YouTube (Spotify doesn't allow third-party bots to stream its own audio). Control it with Discord slash commands, `!`-prefix text commands, or by logging into the web dashboard with your Discord account. Everything - the Discord bot token, Spotify credentials, and an admin password - is configured through a setup wizard at http:// :[PORT:3005]/setup.html after you start the container. No environment variables required. You'll need a free Discord application (discord.com/developers/applications) and, optionally, a free Spotify application (developer.spotify.com/dashboard) before running the wizard - see the project README for the exact steps.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Stores the SQLite database with your bot credentials, admin password, and per-server settings. Back this up.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the web dashboard and setup wizard
